stopConditions.label: Missing required Site Manifest
stopConditions.reason: Contract-dependent implementation cannot safely resolve project intent.

stopConditions.label: Invalid Site Manifest
stopConditions.reason: Fix or explicitly migrate the Manifest before contract-dependent work.

stopConditions.label: Unsupported pinned Contract Version
stopConditions.reason: Do not silently move to a supported version.

stopConditions.label: Unknown Module or Capability
stopConditions.reason: Do not invent a project-local canonical identifier.

stopConditions.label: Conflicting canonical definitions
stopConditions.reason: Resolve the authoritative contract before implementation.

stopConditions.label: No canonical contract covers required shared behavior
Required canonical API operation is missing
Protected operation lacks a canonical Permission
Required external provider behavior lacks a canonical Connector
Implementation would expose a secret to public client code
stopConditions.reason: Move the operation to a trusted server boundary.

stopConditions.label: Commerce transaction invariant or state transition is ambiguous
Destructive persisted-data change lacks migration/recovery plan
Production-destructive action lacks explicit scope/intent
stopConditions.reason: Do not infer permission to destroy production data or state.

stopConditions.label: Sensitive/personal data transmission or retention classification is unknown
Task would require changing pinned Contract Version implicitly
stopConditions.reason: Upgrade must be explicit and compatibility-reviewed.

stopConditions.label: Required change targets generated output but authoritative source/generator is unclear
stopConditions.reason: Find and change the source rather than hand-editing generated output.
